meta.source: Bradford White atmospheric vent gas water heater specification sheet (C1101-B-0618); Whirlpool brand limited warranty (American Water Heater Company, form 100236126); American Water Heaters product support page titles; Rheem product names on Home Depot listings (data/cost-ranges.json)
meta.notes: Model number rules for the model number lookup. Only segments a maker's own document states, or that hold for every listing we have, are decoded; anything else on the label is read by the visitor. Patterns are tried in order. fields.<name>.group is the regex group; map turns a code into words. Rheem has no public model number key, so the Rheem rule is checked by build:data against every Rheem tank listing in data/cost-ranges.json (gallons, height, warranty and input in the product name); a mismatch fails the build. A. O. Smith, State, Rinnai, Noritz, Navien and Takagi model numbers are not decoded: no source we could open states their key. Review with data/serial-formats.json.

rheem.label: Rheem
rheem.scope: Rheem tank models whose number starts with XG (gas) or XE (electric and heat pump): the Performance, Performance Plus, Performance Platinum, Gladiator and ProTerra lines

patterns.segments: X + G (gas) or E (electric) · gallons · T, S or M (tall, short, medium) · warranty years · series letters · input (thousand BTU/h for gas, hundred watts for electric) · U + revision

input.zeroMeans: no element rating in the number (120-volt plug-in heat pump)

patterns.source: Rheem product names on The Home Depot listings: every XG/XE tank listing in data/cost-ranges.json names the same gallons, height, warranty years and BTU or watt rating that this rule reads from its model number (checked by npm run build:data)

bradford-white.label: Bradford White
bradford-white.scope: Bradford White residential atmospheric vent gas models (model numbers starting RG)

patterns.segments: RG + series digit · gallon size class · profile letter · warranty years (6 or 10) · N (natural gas) or X (propane)
patterns.quote: For Propane (LP) models change suffix “N” to “X”. For 10 year models, change suffix from “6” to “10”.
patterns.source: Bradford White, Residential Atmospheric Vent Gas Water Heater specification sheet (C1101-B-0618): model table with nominal gallons, and the notes on the N/X and 6/10 suffixes

whirlpool.label: Whirlpool
whirlpool.scope: Whirlpool brand residential water heaters made by American Water Heater Company

patterns.segments: the number after the first letters, before the dash, is the warranty code (6, 9 or 12)
patterns.source: Whirlpool brand residential water heater limited warranty (American Water Heater Company, February 2015, form 100236126): model number example 30T6-30NG and the warranty code table

american.label: American
american.scope: American Water Heaters residential tanks with model numbers like G61-50T40 or E10N-40L

patterns.segments: G or E, then the warranty years (6 or 10) before the dash
patterns.source: American Water Heaters product support pages: model titles end in "6-year warranty" or "10-year warranty" (G61-50T40, G101-50T40, E6N-30L, E10N-40L and others)

warrantyStart.quote: If the inner tank leaks within the warranty period listed on the data plate label after the original installation, Manufacturer will furnish a new water heater
warrantyStart.source: Whirlpool brand residential water heater limited warranty (American Water Heater Company): the tank warranty runs from the original installation

labelFields.means: The product: maker, size, fuel and often the warranty length. Decoded below for the brands we can source.
This one unit. Most brands hide the build date in its first characters.
Nominal storage. The real volume is usually a little less; tankless units show none.
Burner size for gas, element wattage for electric. A tankless gas unit shows a maximum and a minimum.
The only gas the unit may burn without a conversion kit from the maker.
Electric units: the supply the elements need, usually 240 V single phase.
The highest water pressure the tank is built for, usually 150 psi; the relief valve matches it.
How much hot water it delivers in a busy hour and how efficiently. Often on the yellow EnergyGuide label, not the rating plate.

labelFieldsSource: Hot Water Math summary of the rating plate fields; working pressure and LP/N suffix from the Bradford White specification sheet (150 psi working pressure)
